name: H3 per-step audio shift curve
plain: Multiplies the H3 audio shift by a user-drawn curve over the steps. A flat curve at 1.0 changes nothing. It only rewrites the transformer option for each step and leaves the model_sampling object alone, so the audio carry scale used for latent in and out stays at its fixed value.
math:
p = step index/(n−1), from the nearest entry in sample_sigmas.
mult = lo + curve(p)·(hi−lo). shift_a = clamp(base·mult, 0.5, 30), written to minimax_h3_sigma_shift_audio.
In core, this key sets the carry σ_a/σ_v and the audio t label, while audio_scale = shift_v/shift_a in ModelSamplingAV is unchanged.

props.shape: multiplier curve on the audio shift

claims.text: Node text: low shift means audio resolves early and video locks on
claims.label: from pack README claim

label: from code
surprise: The time-varying shift disagrees with the fixed audio_scale at most steps (core carries by σ_a/σ_v and scales latents by shift_v/shift_a), so the audio stream's effective schedule is not a plain re-shift. Inference from reading both; not measured.
